item.text: Проверяю реализацию на корректность ключевых сценариев и ошибок, затем устраню найденные недочёты.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/csv-insights.XXXXXX)
printf '"'team,name,amount\\na,\"Doe, Jane\",1.50\\na,\"Line\\nbreak\",2.50\\nb,Bob,3\\n' > \""'$tmpdir/input.csv"
python3 main.py "$tmpdir/input.csv" --where team=a --output json
python3 main.py "$tmpdir/input.csv" --group-by team --sum amount --avg amount --output json
python3 main.py "$tmpdir/input.csv" --where team=b --output csv
printf '"'x,y\\na,\\n' > \""'$tmpdir/bad.csv"
if python3 main.py "$tmpdir/bad.csv" --group-by x --sum y >"$tmpdir/out" 2>"$tmpdir/err"; then exit 1; fi
rg "row 2, column '"'y': blank\" \""'$tmpdir/err"
printf '"'x,x\\n1,2\\n' > \""'$tmpdir/dupe.csv"
if python3 main.py "$tmpdir/dupe.csv" >"$tmpdir/out" 2>"$tmpdir/err"; then exit 1; fi
rg '"'headers must be unique' \""'$tmpdir/err"
printf '"'x,y\\n1\\n' > \""'$tmpdir/short.csv"
if python3 main.py "$tmpdir/short.csv" >"$tmpdir/out" 2>"$tmpdir/err"; then exit 1; fi
rg '"'row 2 has 1 fields; expected 2' \""'$tmpdir/err"
rm -rf "$tmpdir"'

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '100,260p' main.py
python3 main.py --help >/dev/null
workdir_case="'$(mktemp -d /tmp/csv-insights-case.XXXXXX)
printf '"'g,n\\nb,1.20\\na,0.01\\na,2.49\\n' > \""'$workdir_case/data.csv"
python3 main.py "$workdir_case/data.csv" --group-by g --sum n --avg n --output csv > "$workdir_case/result.csv"
printf '"'g,sum_n,avg_n\\na,2.5,1.25\\nb,1.2,1.2\\n' | cmp -s - \""'$workdir_case/result.csv"
for cmd in '"\\
  \"python3 main.py '"'$workdir_case/data.csv'"' --sum n\" \\
  \"python3 main.py '"'$workdir_case/data.csv'"' --where malformed\" \\
  \"python3 main.py '"'$workdir_case/data.csv'"' --where z=1\" \\
  \"python3 main.py '"'$workdir_case/data.csv'"' --group-by z\"; do
  if eval \""'$cmd" >"$workdir_case/out" 2>"$workdir_case/err"; then exit 1; fi
done
rm -rf "$workdir_case"'
